newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish April M2 money supply up 1.0 pct -cen bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish April M2 money supply up 1.0 pct -cen bank.

text.p: Finland's M2 money aggregate rose one percent year-on-year in April after a 2.1 percent rise in March, the Bank of Finland said on Thursday.
NOTE: M1 comprises currency in circulation, and cheques, giro and transaction accounts.
M2 comprises M1 and fixed-term and other bank deposits held by the public.
M3 comprises M2 plus outstanding bank certificates of deposit held by the public.
The Bank of Finland has not published targets for the money aggregates, but it has said they are among the economic indicators it monitors to quide monetary policy.
